  <name>Task 1: LibraryStore duplicate, remove, deterministic ordering, rejected count and create guard</name>
  <files>apps/web/src/app/stores/library.store.ts, apps/web/src/app/stores/library.store.spec.ts, apps/web/src/app/integration/library-crud.integration.spec.ts</files>

  </read_first>
  <behavior>
    - duplicate(id) of a character named 'Ari' returns a new id, not the original; the library then holds 'Ari' and 'Ari (copy)' with distinct ids, and the copy's pages are a deep copy (mutating the copy's array in memory does not change the original's stored record)
    - duplicate on a character whose name is 120 'x' characters yields a name with at most 120 code points ending in ' (copy)'; an empty name yields 'Untitled character (copy)'
    - duplicate twice yields two distinct copies
    - remove(id) deletes the record; remove(id) again resolves and summaries stay unchanged
    - Three characters with updatedAt values T2, T1, T1 and names 'b', 'a', 'a' sort as T2 first, then the two T1 rows ordered by id ascending
    - Two concurrent create() calls resolve to the same id and exactly one record exists afterwards
    - refresh() sets rejectedCount to the number of LibraryListing.rejected entries
    - Integration: create, rename via repo.put, duplicate, delete the original, then TestBed.resetTestingModule() and a fresh LibraryStore with refresh() lists exactly the copy
  </behavior>
  <action>
Per SPEC-frontend-architecture section 3 and ADR-0003, extend LibraryStore. Keep the existing signatures.

- Add `rejectedCount = signal(0)` and `creating = signal(false)`.
- `refresh()` maps LibraryListing.characters to CharacterSummary, where pageTypes comes from `pages.map(p => p.type)`. It sorts by updatedAt descending, then name via `localeCompare(other, undefined, { sensitivity: 'base' })`, then id ascending. It sets `rejectedCount` from `rejected.length`.
- `create()` is guarded: while a create is in flight, return the same pending promise. It sets `creating` true, builds `createEmptyCharacter(crypto.randomUUID(), new Date().toISOString())`, calls repo.put and refresh, and returns the id. `creating` is reset in a `finally`.
- `duplicate(id)` loads the source via repo.get and throws if it is null. It builds the copy:
  - a new `crypto.randomUUID()`
  - core copied with the name computed as: base = the trimmed name, or 'Untitled character' if empty; base truncated with `Array.from(base).slice(0, NAME_MAX - 7).join('')` (code points, the same unit Zod counts), then ' (copy)' appended
  - portrait reference kept, since images are content-addressed and shared
  - pages via structuredClone
  - createdAt and updatedAt both set to now, and schemaVersion unchanged
  It then calls repo.put and refresh, and returns the new id.
- `remove(id)` calls repo.delete then refresh. IndexedDB delete of a missing key succeeds, so a second remove is a no-op.

The store never calls confirm; confirmation belongs to the page (Task 2).
  </action>
  <verify>
    <automated>pnpm --filter @dossier/schema build && pnpm --filter web exec ng test --watch=false --include=src/app/stores/library.store.spec.ts --include=src/app/integration/library-crud.integration.spec.ts</automated>
    <fails_when>non-zero exit, or "No tests found" in the output</fails_when>
  </verify>
  <acceptance_criteria>
    - Both spec files pass and cover every behavior bullet.
    - `rg -q 'Array.from\(' apps/web/src/app/stores/library.store.ts` exits 0 (code-point truncation).
    - `rg -q 'confirm\(' apps/web/src/app/stores/library.store.ts` exits 1 (the store has no UI concerns).
    - `rg -q 'structuredClone\(' apps/web/src/app/stores/library.store.ts` exits 0.
  </acceptance_criteria>
  <done>The store offers create, duplicate, remove and refresh with deterministic order, idempotent delete, a guarded create, and correct copy semantics, proven over a simulated reload.</done>
</task>

    - With confirm returning true, the row disappears and the record is gone after refresh
    - An empty library renders the text 'No characters yet' and a New character button
    - A character with an empty name renders the label 'Untitled character'

  <action>
Build LibraryPage per SPEC-design-system (ADR-0015) and CHAR-02. Use a standalone component, ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush, signals, and `@if` / `@for` with track on id.

- Header row: `<h1>Library</h1>` and a `.primary` New character button, disabled while `store.creating()`. Clicking it calls `store.create()`; plan 01-06 adds navigation to the new character.
- Rejected notice: when `store.rejectedCount() > 0`, a `role="status"` notice reading: "(n) saved character(s) could not be opened. They were saved by a newer version of Character Dossier or are damaged, and have not been changed."
- Empty state: when summaries are empty and loading is false, "No characters yet" plus a line inviting the user to create one.
- Row list as `<ul>`, each `<li>` a `.card`-styled row with:
  - the name, or 'Untitled character' in --text-muted if empty, as a `routerLink` to `['/c', s.id]` with min-height var(--touch-target-min)
  - the species in --text-muted
  - updatedAt through the `date: 'medium'` pipe
  - a `.ghost` Duplicate button with `aria-label="Duplicate (name)"` calling `store.duplicate(s.id)`
  - a `.ghost .danger` Delete button with `aria-label="Delete (name)"` that calls `store.remove(s.id)` only if `window.confirm('Delete “(name)”? This cannot be undone.')` returns true
- Buttons have 44 px hit areas with `gap: var(--space-2)` between them.
- At 400 px the row wraps its actions below the name (flex-wrap, min-width: 0). Long names wrap via the global overflow-wrap rule.
- Render every user string with interpolation only; never bind raw HTML.
- `store.refresh()` runs on construction.
  </action>

<threat_model>
## Trust Boundaries

| Boundary | Description |
|----------|-------------|
| stored character strings to DOM | Names and species are user-entered and later (Phase 3) arrive from other people's shares |

## STRIDE Threat Register

| Threat ID | Category | Component | Severity | Disposition | Mitigation Plan |
|-----------|----------|-----------|----------|-------------|-----------------|
| T-01-05-01 | Tampering | LibraryPage rendering of names | medium | mitigate | Interpolation-only rendering (Angular auto-escapes); the acceptance check asserts no raw-HTML binding in pages/library. |
| T-01-05-02 | Tampering | Delete action | medium | mitigate | window.confirm names the character before store.remove; the spec proves the cancel path leaves the record. |
| T-01-05-03 | Denial of Service | large libraries | low | accept | Hobby scale at about 30 KB per character; a whole-list render is acceptable, and virtual scrolling is not in any requirement. |
</threat_model>
